name: macd_histogram_divergence_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY experiences a sustained intraday decline, algorithmic momentum sellers execute in sequential waves. Each wave encounters better-rested resting buy orders at each new price low, causing the rate of decline to diminish even as price continues lower. The MACD histogram (12/26/9 on 5s bars ≈ 60s/130s/45s windows) captures this exhaustion precisely: a shallower histogram trough compared to the prior trough, while price prints a new low, reveals that NIFTY's net selling force is contracting. The histogram zero-cross above 0 then confirms that VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers have begun active accumulation, producing a sharp 15-30 second bounce. The symmetric bearish divergence — higher price highs with lower histogram peaks — flags institutional buy-side exhaustion where resting sell orders at new highs are absorbing demand more effectively, preceding a sharp fade.

indicators.name: ema_12
indicators.purpose: Fast EMA over 12 bars = 60 seconds. NOT scaled from original 12-minute EMA — instead compressed to 60s because our divergence patterns form over 2-4 minutes total (two wave cycles of ~1-2 min each). At 60s, this EMA tracks the fast momentum within each wave.

indicators.name: ema_26
indicators.purpose: Slow EMA over 26 bars = 130 seconds. At 130s this captures the medium-term reference level for the diverging momentum. The 130s window aligns with typical NIFTY algo TWAP sub-order execution cycles. Original was 26-minute EMA; we use 26-bar at 5s = 2.2 minutes, which matches our hold time scale.

indicators.name: macd_signal
indicators.purpose: Signal line over 9 bars = 45 seconds, smoothing out within-wave oscillations. 9-bar at 5s ≈ 45s is the appropriate smoothing window for 30-120s trades.

indicators.name: macd_hist
indicators.purpose: Histogram = rate-of-change of momentum. Positive when fast EMA is rising faster than slow EMA. Divergence occurs when price makes new extreme but histogram does not — confirming that momentum fuel is depleted.

indicators.name: pivot_lows
indicators.formula: swing low with 3-bar lookback each side
indicators.purpose: 3-bar pivot = 15s on each side for a 30s confirmation window. Original used 5-bar on 1-min bars = 5 min each side; we compress to 3-bar (15s) to match our hold time. Shorter pivot lookback means more pivots but at the 5s frequency this is the right granularity to detect intraday micro-waves.

conditions: Second confirmed price pivot low < first pivot low by >= price_div_min spots
MACD histogram at second pivot trough > histogram at first pivot trough by >= hist_div_min
Histogram crosses above 0 after divergence confirmed (within 60 bars = 5 min)
buy_ce.confirmation: MACD histogram zero-cross upward after bullish divergence

conditions: Second confirmed price pivot high > first pivot high by >= price_div_min spots
MACD histogram at second pivot peak < histogram at first pivot peak by >= hist_div_min
Histogram crosses below 0 after divergence confirmed (within 60 bars = 5 min)
buy_pe.confirmation: MACD histogram zero-cross downward after bearish divergence

entry.entry_price: limit at candle close on zero-cross bar

exit.stop_rationale: After histogram zero-cross, a continuation of 8+ NIFTY spot points against position (≈4 option pts at delta 0.5) negates the divergence thesis — it means a fresh momentum leg is underway. NIFTY's typical 1-min move is 3-7 option pts; stopping at 4 prevents riding a new trend while allowing normal post-zero-cross noise.
exit.target_rationale: Divergence-driven bounces on NIFTY typically span 15-25 spot points (≈7-12 option pts at delta 0.5) from histogram zero-cross to the first resistance. Targeting 7 pts captures the first 50-60% of the expected move at 1:1.75 R:R, exiting before the bounce stalls at VWAP or prior pivot.

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — high VIX regimes cause divergence failures (panic selling overrides exhaustion signals)
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST — skip first 15 min opening noise and last 10 min closing auction
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is synthetic and noisy at 5s
filters.trend_filter: none — counter-trend by design, divergence is anti-momentum
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — MACD divergence is publicly known but real-time automated pivot detection at 5s on index is uncommon

adaptation_notes: Original used 12/26/9 on 1-minute bars of individual FNO stocks over 15-60 min holds. Conversion compresses to 5-second bars on NIFTY index with the SAME 12/26/9 bar counts but now representing 60s/130s/45s windows instead of 12/26/9 minutes — correctly calibrated for 30-120s holds. Pivot lookback compressed from 5-bar (5 min each side) to 3-bar (15s each side) to match the faster cadence. The core divergence thesis is identical but now targets micro-wave exhaustion on NIFTY's institutional flow patterns rather than individual stock reversals. VIX filter retained at 22 to skip panic regimes where divergence repeatedly fails.
weaknesses: Pivot detection at 3-bar (15s) resolution produces many false pivots on NIFTY's continuous tick stream — noise-to-signal ratio is higher than on 1-min stock bars.
MACD(12,26,9) warm-up at 5s frequency requires only ~30 bars (2.5 min) but genuine divergence requires two pivots separated by meaningful time — early session divergences may be premature.
Zero-cross entry after divergence adds lag — by the time histogram crosses zero, 30-60% of the first reversal leg may already be captured by faster participants.
Limited to 6 trades/day given divergence patterns are rare; low trade count limits statistical significance in 12-day backtest window.
